decision: Retain the allowance guard, prepared call-target cache, indexed continuation changes and address/fetch fusion as a modest interpreter improvement. Discard the local-instruction-copy follow-up. Physical typing remains far from fluid.
method: Alternating previous/current clean source heads in the same checkout, serial fresh source-mode Desktop runs. Same CPU observer and unchanged budgets. Physical latencies include this observer; compare runs within this series. Native timing covers only the isolated-character interval, not the burst.
limitations: First-character timing includes the same CPU observer; native profiling is disabled for the burst. Final unprofiled qualification is separate.
Shared-host timings are observations, not precise causal speedups or confidence intervals. Native timing overlaps owner intervals; these timing domains must not be added or subtracted.
Whole physical intervals contain slightly different idle work; bounded kernels separately require exact work/results across all trials.
The rejected local-instruction-copy experiment remains in the kernel evidence.

profile.method: SIGUSR1 before first send_text; SIGUSR2 at first subsequent complete-offer observation. Interval starts and stops on existing owner boundaries. Signal delivery can add idle boundaries; native counters freeze at stop. Physical trace includes this observer and is a paired diagnostic, not an unprofiled benchmark.
